description_en: Group of fiveśikharatemples (pañcadevala) located in the village of Koligāũ. They are found on the northern side of the road between Basantapura and Sipkhānā. The monuments are organised around one central temple (KLK0160-002). This setting reflects thesmārtaworship of Hindu gods. The religious affiliation of the temple is Hindu, as is indicated by the presence of sculptures of Gaṇeśa and a multi-armed deity, probably Viṣṇu.In West Nepal śikhara temples are known asdevala. Thepañcadevalaplan is mostly found in the districts of Dailekh, Achham and Kalikot, which corresponds to the area controlled by the Rāskoṭi kings. This dynasty ruled between the end of the 14th century and the end of the 18th century. In the absence of epigraphic records it is possible to date the Koligāũ Pañcadevala between the 13th and the 15th century.The northern (KLK0160-005) and southern (KLK0160-006) monuments are most likely later additions to an original plan that only had three temples. This is indicated by their reduced dimensions and by the fact that they are mainly constituted of piled-up architectural elements coming from at least anotherśikharatemples. The monuments have all been white-washed.
description_ne: यी पाँचवटा शिखर शैलीमा बनेका मन्दिरहरूको समूह बसन्तपुर र सिप्खानाको बिचतिर सडकको उत्तरतर्फ कोलिगाऊँ भन्ने ठाउँमा छन् । यी पाँचवटा मन्दिरहरूको अभिलेखीकरण गर्दा केन्द्रमा अवस्थित मन्दिरलाई (KLK0160-002) मुख्य मानी गरिएको छ । यी मन्दिरहरूको अवस्थिति हेर्दा यहाँ स्मार्त हिन्दु परम्परा रहेको जस्तो देखिन्छ । यी मन्दिरमा रहेका गणेश र धेरै हात भएका सम्भवतः विष्णुका मूर्तिहरूले यो कुरा पुष्टि गर्दछन् । पश्चिम नेपालमा शिखर शैलीमा बनेका मन्दिरहरूलाइ देवल भन्ने प्रचलन छ । पञ्चदेवलहरू धेरैजसो दैलेख, अछाम र कालीकोट जिल्लाहरूमा देख्न सकिन्छ । यी जिल्लाहरू रास्कोटी राजाहरूले शासन गरेका ठाउँहरू हुन् । यी राजाहरूका वंशले ईशाको चौधौंदेखि अठारौं शताब्दीसम्म राज गरेको देखिन्छ । यी पञ्चदेवलहरू ईशाको तेह्रौंदेखि पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीभित्र बनेको अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । उत्तर (KLK0160-005) र दक्षिणतर्फका (KLK0160-006) देवल सम्भवतः अरु तीन देवलहरूभन्दा अलि पछि बनाएको हुनुपर्दछ । यी देवलहरूमा सेतो रङ्ग पोतिएको छ ।
references: REFERENCES Andolfatto, D. C. 2019. Le Pays aux Cent-Vingt-Cinq-Mille Montagnes. Etude Archéologique du Bassin de la Karnali (Népal) entre le XIIe et le XVIe siècle . Paris: Sorbonne Université.
